title: R-Studio Restart possibly required to show Mapbox-gl in Window and Viewerpane
description: This was an issue with Vector Tiles not initially showing in R-Studio, and only in external browser. A R-Studio restart seemed to have cleared the issue.

title: Multiple Mabox GL Layers
description:
It appears that some sort of error exists in the code which prevents multiple mapbox layers from being stacked on top of each other via layers control. 

Layers control in the below example is illustrative of the problem.  Only one layer appears to be visible unless the other is turned off.

```
m = leaflet() %>%
	setView(-100, 40, zoom = 5) %>%
	addMapPane("background_map", zIndex = 1) %>%    # Level 1: bottom
	addProviderTiles(providers$Stamen.TonerLite,
		options = pathOptions(pane = "background_map")) %>%
	addMapboxGL( 'mapbox://styles/thirdhuman/cjtufrvxo19yw1fq9l297qg5i',
		group = "Non-LIC Contiguous",
		layerId = "CONT")%>%
	addMapboxGL('mapbox://styles/thirdhuman/cju03wxu5013m1fqwi6vbuqa1',
		group = "Low-Income Community",
		layerId = "LIC") %>%
	# addProviderTiles(providers$Stamen.TonerLabels, group = 'labels',
	# 	options = pathOptions(pane = "labels")) %>%
		addLayersControl(
			overlayGroups = c('Low-Income Community' , "Non-LIC Contiguous"),
			options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE))

m

```

title: addMapboxGL() not working on Windows
description:
The following code worked when tested on a Mac, but not on Windows.

``` r
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.mapboxgl)

access_token <- "redacted"
style_url <- "mapbox://styles/stanford-datalab/cjsqj3qvi3zrf1fld8qvywggs"

leaflet(width = 950, height = 800)  %>% 
  addMapboxGL(
    accessToken = access_token,
    style = style_url
  )
```

title: Cannot zoom in or out after map loads
description:
@jcheng5 @mikelmaron @mourner

We want to render a custom Mapbox style using `addMapboxGL()`. Here's my code:

```
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.mapboxgl)

leaflet() %>% 
  addMapboxGL(
    style = "mapbox://styles/sarakai24/cjsnsfr4o6qeg1fqgp63ilzjj"
  )
```
Upon loading, you cannot zoom the map out. If you zoom in, the map jumps to the lowest zoom level.

Once the map has jumped to the lowest zoom level, you can zoom in and out.
